title: IconButton
description: A compact button that only shows an icon. With pressed / defaultPressed it becomes a toggle button (favorite, like, mute...).

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon element to display (children are used when omitted)

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the button, also shown as its tooltip (unless showTooltip is false). Takes precedence over aria-label

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color of the button

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `ghost` (transparent until hovered), `solid` (filled with the color) or `outline` (bordered)

props.name: size
props.description: Button size

props.name: shape
props.description: Button shape

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and removes it from the tab order

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the icon with a spinner and ignores activation (click, Enter, Space, form submission) while staying focusable: exposed as aria-busy + aria-disabled instead of the native disabled attribute

props.name: pressed
props.description: Pressed state of a toggle button (controlled; pair with onPressedChange). Setting pressed, defaultPressed or onPressedChange makes the button a toggle: clicking flips the state and it is exposed as aria-pressed

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Initial pressed state of an uncontrolled toggle button

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip configuration (content, color, variant, shape, arrow); requires showTooltip

props.name: showTooltip
props.description: Shows the tooltip on hover and focus (its content is tooltip.content, or the label)

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label; always set it, since the button only contains an icon

events.name: onPressedChange
events.description: Called with the new pressed state when a toggle button is activated

IconButtonProps.description: Styling hooks (CSS custom properties, set them on the button or an ancestor): `--icon-button-color` (icon color), `--icon-button-hover-bg` (hover background), `--icon-button-pressed-color` and `--icon-button-pressed-bg` (pressed toggle state).

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Add increases the item counter. Settings and Delete illustrate accessible icon action labels.

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: color applies a semantic color: neutral (default), primary, success, warning, danger or info.

examples.title: Custom colors
examples.description: Override the resolved colors with CSS custom properties: --icon-button-color (icon), --icon-button-hover-bg (hover background), --icon-button-pressed-color and --icon-button-pressed-bg (pressed toggle). Set them inline, in a class or on an ancestor.

examples.title: Label and tooltip
examples.description: label names the button and is shown as its tooltip; the icon can be passed as children. variant sets the visual style and color the semantic color.

examples.title: Search button
examples.description: A search action is an IconButton with a search icon and a label; with type="submit" it submits its form, and loading blocks it while the search runs. Use a Button when the action needs visible text.

examples.title: Sizes and shapes
examples.description: Three sizes (small, medium, large) and two shapes (circle, square).

examples.title: States
examples.description: loading replaces the icon with a spinner and keeps the button focusable (aria-busy + aria-disabled) while ignoring activation, pressed marks a toggle as on and disabled sets the native disabled attribute, which removes the button from the tab order.

examples.title: Toggle button
examples.description: Like starts off and updates its feedback; Bookmark starts on and Mute starts off.

examples.title: Tooltip
examples.description: Set showTooltip and tooltip to describe the action on hover and keyboard focus.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: variant sets the visual style: ghost (default, transparent until hovered), solid (filled with the color) or outline (bordered).

cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed toggle
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the button (every size; defaults follow the density's control heights)
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Font size of the icon (every size)
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the square shape (defaults to --radius-lg)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: label names the icon-only button and is shown as its tooltip on hover and focus (Escape closes it). Ghost and neutral by default.

sizes-shapes.title: Sizes, shapes and colors
sizes-shapes.description: Four sizes, circle or square shapes, and the shared semantic colors with the solid / outline / ghost variants.

toggle.title: Toggle buttons
toggle.description: toggle exposes aria-pressed; activation flips pressed and fires a cancelable minerva-pressed-change. The pin cannot be turned off (preventDefault).

states.title: Loading, disabled and tooltips
states.description: Click Refresh to see the loading state (still focusable, activation ignored). tooltip overrides the tooltip text, tooltip-placement moves it, no-tooltip removes it.

props.toggle: Makes it a toggle button (exposes aria-pressed).
props.noTooltip: Hides the tooltip (the label still names the button).
props.type: What the button does in its form: nothing (button), submit or reset.

events.minerva-pressed-change: A toggle button was activated (detail: { pressed }, the new state). Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.

cssVars.--tooltip-max-width: Maximum width of the tooltip (capped by the viewport).
cssVars.--tooltip-z-index: Stacking order of the tooltip (defaults to --z-popover).

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner button.
methods.click: Clicks the inner button (ignored while disabled or loading).
